title: Tony Haile (Chartbeat, Scroll founder) on X — 'one of the few essential thinkers for entrepreneurs'
summary: Tony Haile, the founder of Chartbeat and Scroll, traces his 16-year arc with Eric's work — from the 2010 Startup Lessons Learned compilation to Incorruptible.
blockquote: Back in 2010, I bought @ericries' Startup Lessons Learned compilation after loving his blog. 16 years later, I'm still learning from him with his great new book 'Incorruptible'. One of the few essential thinkers for entrepreneurs.
